features.title: From raw data to a set of materials someone can check
features.subtitle: Six areas covering the path from data capture to export for independent review.

items.title: Guided VSME
items.text: The VSME Basic B1–B11 disclosure structure; Comprehensive C1–C9 on Pro and above.

items.title: GHG calculations
items.text: Scope 1 and 2 on every plan. Scope 3 at the depth your plan covers.

items.title: Evidence trail
items.text: Store the source, period, unit, factor, calculation method and supporting file.

items.title: Entities and sites
items.text: Separate data by legal entity and site; the limits are visible before you pick a plan.

items.title: Supplier registry
items.text: A registry of your suppliers with their ESG data on Pro and Enterprise. Your company fills it in; we do not send questionnaires to suppliers.

items.title: Exports
items.text: PDF and Excel on every plan. Other formats appear only once they are actually ready.

process.title: Five steps from reporting boundaries to export
process.subtitle: Each step maps to a screen in the platform and to a concrete result.

steps.title: Set the boundaries
steps.action: Legal entities, sites, period, currency and consolidation method.

steps.title: Fill in VSME
steps.action: Guided disclosures B1–B11; C1–C9 depending on the plan.
steps.result: Completeness status and a list of gaps.

steps.title: Add activity data
steps.action: Energy, fuels, business travel, purchases and their sources.
steps.result: A verifiable basis for the calculations.

steps.title: Check the calculations
steps.action: Factor, unit, method, estimated-or-actual flag and evidence.

steps.title: Export
steps.action: PDF and Excel, plus a package for independent review.

process.boundary: Hosmos prepares the data and the materials. An independent limited-assurance review is performed by a licensed audit firm under a separate contract. Publication in AJPES is a separate step as well.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The commercial and regulatory questions that come up before a demo.

items.a: A voluntary European sustainability reporting standard for non-listed micro, small and medium-sized enterprises. Hosmos structures data collection at the VSME depth you choose.
No. The platform helps prepare the data, the calculations and the export. An independent review is performed by a licensed audit firm under a separate contract.

Every plan estimates categories 1 and 2 (purchased goods and services, capital goods) from your annual spend with EXIOBASE factors. The estimate is reported separately from the Scope 1 and 2 totals and is marked as an estimate. The other 13 categories are not covered.

items.q: What does the annual subscription include?
items.a: Access to the features of the chosen plan for 12 months. Expert services, independent review and AJPES publication are not included unless stated separately.
A separate first-year path: SaaS Pro at €1,000 plus expert preparation of the VSME report at €2,000 — €3,000 excluding VAT in total. It is not an additional SaaS tier.

items.q: Does Hosmos guarantee an SPS subsidy?
items.a: No. SPS decides on the application and on the eligibility of costs. Under the published conditions, co-financing of 60% of eligible costs is possible within set limits.

items.q: Are AJPES publication and independent review included?
items.a: No. Both are arranged and paid for separately.

items.q: Do you support XBRL, iXBRL, CDP, SBTi or TCFD?
items.a: We do not promise these capabilities on this page until they are actually ready and verified. They may be enabled later.

items.q: How does Enterprise differ from White Label?
items.a: Enterprise is a SaaS plan for a group of up to 10 legal entities with unlimited sites and team seats. White Label is a separate contractual configuration under a partner's brand.
